summary: Implemented P33-T4: Automatic recovery logic with exponential backoff after extended fallback. Extended DegradationTracker with per-tick-type probe-retry state (fallback_activated_day, consecutive_failure_cycles, next_probe_day, explicitly_disengaged) and three new methods: notify_auto_fallback_active, record_probe_outcome, should_probe, get_backoff_state. Modified simulate_day_bridged to use probe logic at T1/T2/T4 check points. Updated AppraisalAuditLog with probe_attempted and probe_backoff_state metadata fields. Wrote 30 new tests covering all acceptance criteria.

diff_summary.back/app/llm/degradation_tracker.py: Added 4 new fields (base_cooldown=1, multiplier=2, max_cooldown=14, fallback_activated_day, consecutive_failure_cycles, next_probe_day, explicitly_disengaged). Added notify_auto_fallback_active(), record_probe_outcome(), should_probe(), get_backoff_state() methods. Modified is_auto_fallback_active() to check explicitly_disengaged flag. Modified record_outcome() to clear explicitly_disengaged on non-acceptable outcomes.
diff_summary.back/app/llm/appraisal_audit_log.py: Added probe_attempted (dict[str, bool]) and probe_backoff_state (dict[str, dict]) fields to AppraisalAuditLog.
diff_summary.back/app/engines/tick_bridge.py: Added OutcomeClass import. For T1, T2, T4: replaced simple is_auto_fallback_active binary check with 3-branch logic (regular auto-fallback / probe attempt / normal path). Added notify_auto_fallback_active and should_probe calls. Probe path calls route() and records outcome via both record_outcome and record_probe_outcome. Updated audit log assembly to populate probe_attempted and probe_backoff_state.
diff_summary.back/tests/test_p33_t4_probe_retry.py: New test file with 30 tests in 7 classes: TestProbeAfterCooldown (7), TestSuccessfulProbeDisengagesFallback (6), TestFailedProbeEscalatesBackoff (4), TestMaxCooldownCap (3), TestMultiDayRecoveryCycle (2), TestMultiDayPersistentFailure (4), TestTrackerSerializationWithProbeState (4).
